copy.headline: Utah visits TCU, close to Big 12 title game with Scalley part of all 10-0 starts
copy.caption:
The higher-than-anticipated pricing signals broad investor enthusiasm for AI stocks even amid some market uncertainty stemming from the departure of Nvidia’s CEO and worries about an AI bubble. But the bigger test will be how Anthropic fares on the stock market.

Anthropic said the offering consists of 980 million shares, roughly 956 million sold by the company and the rest by selling stockholders.

story.title: Utah visits TCU, close to Big 12 title game with Scalley part of all 10-0 starts
story.summary: Anthropic is set to begin trading on the Nasdaq on Thursday after pricing its IPO at $83 per share, valuing the artificial intelligence giant at $1.5 trillion and surpassing SpaceX as the largest initial public offering on record. The higher-than-anticipated pricing signals broad investor enthusiasm for AI stocks even amid some market uncertainty stemming from the departure of Nvidia’s CEO and worries about an AI bubble. But the bigger test will be how Anthropic fares on the stock market. Anthropic said the offering consists of 980 million shares, roughly 956 million sold by the company and the rest by selling stockholders. Proceeds totaling $81 billion put Anthropic’s IPO ahead of SpaceX…
